will_defaults: I will make food decisions that support the outcome I chose.
I will prepare for the moments when convenience tempts me away from the plan.
will_not: I will not pretend one indulgent meal means the plan is broken.
I will not rely on willpower alone when preparation is available.
I will not let stress eat the future I said I wanted.
reality_anchors: Nutrition outcomes reflect repeated daily decisions more than rare extreme efforts.
